unsupported.source: Prioritize whichever class I'm doing worst in.
unsupported.reason: Friday has no way to rank courses by priority, and it doesn't know your grades. I can't work out which class is your weakest.

questions: Which class are you doing worst in? If you tell me, I can add a constraint for it, such as preferring its work at your best times of day or finishing its tasks early.
What would prioritizing that class mean to you? For example: do its work first, finish its tasks days early, or give it your best hours.
